info.title: SDKWork Promotion Backend API
info.description: Backend administration API for campaign, coupon stock, promotion code, and discount operations.

get.summary: Retrieve the coupon-centre operating report for a time window
get.description: Windowed coupon-centre report: counts, basis-point rates, money per currency (budget figures are a current snapshot), and the top offers of the window. Defaults to the last 30 days ending now.

patch.summary: Enable or disable a promotion offer

post.description: Returns the redeemable value of one promotion code and records a `promotion_audit_event` row (`action = codes.reveal`, `aggregate_type = promotion_code`) in the same transaction as the read. The audit row is written first: if that write fails the operation fails and no code is returned. The actor is the authenticated operator; no request field can select it.

post.summary: Export a code batch's promotion codes (audited)
post.description: Returns the redeemable codes of one code batch, ordered by `codeNo`, capped at 5000 rows, and records a `promotion_audit_event` row (`action = codes.export`, `aggregate_type = promotion_code_batch`) in the same transaction as the read. The audit row is written first: if that write fails the operation fails and no code is returned. `truncated` is true when the batch holds more codes than the cap. A batch outside the operator's tenant/organization scope is a 404.

get.description: Paginated code-redemption attempt ledger (successes and failures), newest first by `occurredAt` with `id` as the tiebreaker. Backs the admin support view; `q` searches the submitted-code suffix, the subject id, and the request number. The submitted code itself is never returned.

post.description: Stops a leaked code. Allowed only when `status = 'active'` and the code has never been claimed (`COALESCE(claimed_quantity, 0) = 0`); a claimed code is a `409` ("code has already been claimed and cannot be disabled") and a non-active code is a `409` ("code is not active"). Records a `promotion_audit_event` row (`action = codes.disable`, `aggregate_type = promotion_code`). The audit-evidence row is written inside the same transaction as the mutation and before it; if that write fails the operation fails and nothing is changed. The actor is the IAM-authenticated operator; no request field can select it.

post.summary: Reissue one unused promotion code (lost/compromised code replacement)
post.description: Replaces one unused code with a newly issued one. Allowed only when the original is `status = 'active'` and has never been claimed (`COALESCE(claimed_quantity, 0) = 0`); a claimed code is a `409` ("code has already been claimed and cannot be reissued") and a non-active code is a `409` ("code is not active"). The original becomes `disabled` with `voided_at`/`void_reason` and `replaced_by_code_id`; the replacement is inserted with `reissued_from_code_id`, inheriting the original's `stockId`, `offerId`, `offerVersionId`, `codeBatchId`, `codeType`, validity window, and `maxClaims`, with `status = 'active'` and `claimedQuantity = 0`. Without `code` the value is generated from the code batch's `codePrefix`/`codeLength` (16 characters when the batch defines neither); an explicit `code` is trimmed, upper-cased, validated as 4–64 characters of `A-Z0-9-_`, and must be unique in the tenant (`409` on a collision). The disable, the insert, and the audit-evidence row happen in one transaction, and the audit row (`action = codes.reissue`, `aggregate_type = promotion_code`, `subjectCount = 2`, both ids and the reason in `detailJson`) is written before either mutation. The response carries the new code's id, `codeNo`, display mask, and last four characters plus the replaced id — never the new redeemable value, which stays readable only through the audited reveal (`codes.reveals.create`) and export (`codeBatches.codeExports.create`) operations. The actor is the IAM-authenticated operator; no request field can select it.

parameters.name: codeId
parameters.description: Id of the code being replaced (`promotion_code.id`, TEXT).

201.description: Code reissue with the new code masked

post.summary: Disable a code batch's eligible codes (stop-loss)
post.description: Stops every eligible code of one batch with a single `UPDATE`: codes that are `active` and never claimed are disabled, and the rest are reported as `skippedCount` instead of failing the batch. Records a `promotion_audit_event` row (`action = codes.batch_disable`, `aggregate_type = promotion_code_batch`, `subject_count = disabledCount`). A batch outside the operator's tenant/organization scope is a `404`. The audit-evidence row is written inside the same transaction as the mutation and before it; if that write fails the operation fails and nothing is changed. The actor is the IAM-authenticated operator; no request field can select it.

Voids a wallet coupon that is still usable (`claimed`, `active`, or `pending`, case-insensitive) and records `voided_at` + `void_reason` on the row. A redeemed/used coupon is a `409` ("coupon has already been redeemed"); an already voided/expired/cancelled/disabled coupon is a `409` ("coupon is not active"). Records a `promotion_audit_event` row (`action = user_coupons.void`, `aggregate_type = promotion_user_coupon`). The audit-evidence row is written inside the same transaction as the mutation and before it; if that write fails the operation fails and nothing is changed. The actor is the IAM-authenticated operator; no request field can select it.

Moves a still-usable wallet coupon's expiry (`claimed`, `active`, or `pending`) to `expiresAt`, which must parse as a promotion timestamp and be later than the database clock — the comparison is `(<canonical>)::timestamptz > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP` in SQL, not a Rust clock read. A coupon with no previous expiry is allowed. Records a `promotion_audit_event` row (`action = user_coupons.extend`, `aggregate_type = promotion_user_coupon`, old and new expiry in `detail_json`). The audit-evidence row is written inside the same transaction as the mutation and before it; if that write fails the operation fails and nothing is changed. The actor is the IAM-authenticated operator; no request field can select it.

Moves an `applied` discount application to `settled`: the reserved coupon budget amount moves from `reserved` to `used` in one guarded update, `settledAt` is written on the row, and a `promotion_budget_ledger_entry` row with `direction = settle` is appended. Records a `promotion_audit_event` row (`action = discount_applications.settle`, `aggregate_type = promotion_discount_application`) inside the same transaction and before the mutation; if that write fails the operation fails and nothing changes. A non-`applied` application is a `409` with a state-specific message (`already been settled` / `already been released` / `was rolled back`). The actor is the IAM-authenticated operator; no request field can select it. The operation takes no request body.

Moves an `applied` discount application to `released`: the reserved coupon budget amount goes back to the available pool in one guarded update, `releasedAt` plus `releaseReason` are written on the row, and a `promotion_budget_ledger_entry` row with `direction = release` is appended. Records a `promotion_audit_event` row (`action = discount_applications.release`, `aggregate_type = promotion_discount_application`, reason in `detail_json`) inside the same transaction and before the mutation; if that write fails the operation fails and nothing changes. A non-`applied` application is a `409` with a state-specific message. The actor is the IAM-authenticated operator; no request field can select it.

CodeBatchId.name: code_batch_id
CodeBatchId.description: Filter promotion codes by code batch id

StockId.name: stock_id
StockId.description: Filter code batches by coupon stock id

Outcome.name: outcome
Outcome.description: Filter by attempt outcome. The vocabulary is closed: any other value is rejected with 400 instead of returning an unfiltered list.

CodeId.name: code_id
CodeId.description: Filter by promotion code id (TEXT id, never numeric). Used by the redemption-attempt and discount-application lists.

UserCouponId.name: user_coupon_id
UserCouponId.description: Filter discount applications by the user coupon that produced them (TEXT id, never numeric).

OrderId.name: order_id
OrderId.description: Filter discount applications by the order they were applied to (TEXT id, never numeric).

ReportFrom.name: from
ReportFrom.description: Inclusive start of the report window. Accepts RFC 3339 (for example `2026-10-12T00:00:00Z`) or the canonical server form `2026-10-12 00:00:00` (UTC). Defaults to 30 days before `to`. An unparseable value, or a `from` after `to`, is rejected with 400.

ReportTo.name: to
ReportTo.description: Inclusive end of the report window. Accepts RFC 3339 or the canonical server form `2026-11-11 23:59:59` (UTC). Defaults to now. An unparseable value, or a `from` after `to`, is rejected with 400.

PromotionCodeReissueResponse.description: Code reissue with the new code masked

i18nKey.description: Stable SDKWork message key a client can localize instead of rendering `detail` verbatim. Display metadata only; never used for control flow.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale the server rendered `detail` in. Display metadata only.

instance.description: Request path the problem was raised for (RFC 9457 `instance`).

operationId.description: Operation that raised the problem, for example `redemptionAttempts.list`.

discountType.description: Discount calculation mode. Allowed values: `FIXED` (fixed amount off), `PERCENTAGE` (percentage off; `discountValue` is the percentage), `NONE` (benefit-only coupon; no order discount). Input is case-insensitive; the stored value is upper case.

discountValue.description: Discount value. `FIXED`: the amount off in decimal major units. `PERCENTAGE`: the percentage in the range (0, 100], where `12.5` means 12.50%. `NONE`: must be `0`. Plain non-negative decimal with at most 2 fraction digits: no sign, exponent, comma, or extra precision.

minimumAmount.description: Minimum order amount this coupon requires, in decimal major units (`0` means no minimum). Plain non-negative decimal with at most 2 fraction digits.

maximumDiscountAmount.description: Optional cap on a `PERCENTAGE` discount, in decimal major units. Must be greater than `0`, and is rejected for `FIXED` and `NONE`.

productId.description: Membership product the coupon grants. Required together with skuId and packageId for the order-side redemption path.

packageId.description: Membership package id the coupon grants; must match an active membership package with the declared SKU and duration.

budgetAmountMinor.description: Hard monetary cap of the stock's budget account in integer minor units (int64 decimal string). Null when the stock has no budget account.

budgetAvailableMinor.description: Amount of the stock budget still available to reserve, in integer minor units (int64 decimal string). Null when the stock has no budget account.

budgetReservedMinor.description: Amount of the stock budget currently held by live reservations, in integer minor units (int64 decimal string). Null when the stock has no budget account.

budgetUsedMinor.description: Amount of the stock budget already spent, in integer minor units (int64 decimal string). Null when the stock has no budget account.

promotionCode.description: Full redeemable code. It is still stored plaintext in this phase because the audited `codes.reveals.create` / `codeBatches.codeExports.create` operations return it, so it is not removed yet; uniqueness and redemption lookup use the non-reversible hash of `UPPER(TRIM(code))` (`promotion_code.code_hash`) instead of this value. Deprecated as a list-response field: prefer `codeMasked`/`codeLast4` for display and the audited reveal/export operations for the full value.

codeMasked.description: Masked display form of `promotionCode`: the first four and last four characters when the code has at least 9 characters (`3C76****4E21`), otherwise every character except the last two is masked. Never equal to the full code.

codeLast4.description: Last four characters of the code (fewer when the code is shorter). A stable, non-redeemable fragment safe to show or quote to support.

discountType.description: Monetary discount kind: NONE (benefit-only coupon, no order discount), FIXED (fixed amount off), or PERCENTAGE (percent off).

discountAmount.description: Computed discount actually taken off the order, in integer minor units (currency minor unit, e.g. cents for CNY).

from.description: Inclusive start of the report window, canonical RFC 3339 UTC.

to.description: Inclusive end of the report window, canonical RFC 3339 UTC.

byCurrency.description: Money totals, one row per currency. Money is never summed across currencies.

topOffers.description: Offers with the most wallet coupons redeemed in the window, tie-broken by settled discount amount then offer id.

issuedCodes.description: Promotion codes created in the window (windowed by `promotion_code.created_at`). Shared denominator of every rate.

claimedCoupons.description: Wallet coupons claimed in the window (windowed by `promotion_user_coupon.claimed_at`).

redeemedCoupons.description: Wallet coupons claimed in the window that reached `redeemed`/`used`.

expiredCoupons.description: Wallet coupons claimed in the window that expired.

voidedCoupons.description: Wallet coupons claimed in the window that an operator voided.

disabledCodes.description: Promotion codes created in the window that are currently `disabled`.

applicationsApplied.description: Discount applications created in the window (windowed by `promotion_discount_application.applied_at`), any status.

applicationsSettled.description: Discount applications created in the window that settled.

applicationsReleased.description: Discount applications created in the window that were released.

PromotionReportRates.description: Integer ratios in basis points (100% = 10000), all over the issued-code denominator; 0 when the denominator is 0, clamped to 0..10000.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Each row totals only its own currency.

discountAppliedMinor.description: Sum of `promotion_discount_application.discount_amount` for this currency inside the window, in integer minor units.

discountSettledMinor.description: Sum of discount amounts of applications in this currency and status `settled` inside the window, in integer minor units.

budgetTotalMinor.description: Current snapshot (not window-filtered): sum of `promotion_budget_account.total_amount_minor` for this currency, in integer minor units.

budgetReservedMinor.description: Current snapshot (not window-filtered): sum of `promotion_budget_account.reserved_amount_minor` for this currency, in integer minor units.

budgetUsedMinor.description: Current snapshot (not window-filtered): sum of `promotion_budget_account.used_amount_minor` for this currency, in integer minor units.

redeemed.description: Wallet coupons of this offer redeemed in the window.

discountSettledMinor.description: Settled discount amount of this offer in `currencyCode` inside the window, in integer minor units.

currencyCode.description: The single currency this row's amounts belong to (the currency of the offer's settled amount).

discountType.description: Discount calculation mode. Allowed values: `FIXED` (fixed amount off), `PERCENTAGE` (percentage off; `discountValue` is the percentage), `NONE` (benefit-only coupon; no order discount). Input is case-insensitive; the stored value is upper case.

discountValue.description: Discount value. `FIXED`: the amount off in decimal major units. `PERCENTAGE`: the percentage in the range (0, 100], where `12.5` means 12.50%. `NONE`: must be `0`. Plain non-negative decimal with at most 2 fraction digits: no sign, exponent, comma, or extra precision.

minimumAmount.description: Minimum order amount this coupon requires, in decimal major units (`0` means no minimum). Plain non-negative decimal with at most 2 fraction digits.

maximumDiscountAmount.description: Optional cap on a `PERCENTAGE` discount, in decimal major units. Must be greater than `0`, and is rejected for `FIXED` and `NONE`.

totalQuantity.description: Total quantity. Must be positive for LIMITED stock; 0 allowed for UNLIMITED stock (statistics only)

codeIssueMode.description: Coupon code issuance mode: REALTIME generates a code at claim time; BATCH dispenses a pre-generated pool code

budgetAmountMinor.description: Optional hard monetary cap for this coupon stock, in integer minor units (int64 decimal string, must be > 0 when present). Omitted means no cap and apply never reserves. Amounts are integer minor units; legacy decimal-major offer amounts are converted at the service boundary and are never stored here.

customCodes.description: Full coupon codes defined by the admin. When present, the batch stores these codes verbatim (trimmed and upper-cased) instead of generating prefix plus random suffixes; the array length must equal requestedQuantity and codes must be unique.

maxClaims.description: Redemption cap per generated code. 1 means single use; larger values issue a shared multi-use code.

PromotionRedemptionAttempt.description: One code-redemption attempt (success or failure). Append-only evidence: rows are never updated or deleted. The submitted code itself is never stored or returned, only its suffix.

codeId.description: Resolved promotion code id; null when the submission never matched a code.

submittedCodeSuffix.description: Last four characters of the trimmed submitted code. Never the redeemable value.

subjectType.description: Subject that submitted the code, for example `user`.

subjectId.description: Subject id that submitted the code.

failureCode.description: Closed failure taxonomy; always present when `outcome` is `failed` and null when it is `succeeded`.

failureDetail.description: Human-readable rejection message, truncated to 512 characters. Classification lives in the failure code, so clients must not parse this text.

grantedAmount.description: Granted amount as a decimal string in the smallest currency unit, or granted points for `points_credit`.

requestNo.description: Caller request number that produced the attempt.

orderId.description: Order the code was redeemed against, when the attempt came from an order.

traceId.description: Trace id captured from the redemption command. Empty when the caller supplied none.

occurredAt.description: Instant the attempt was evaluated (server form `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`).

PromotionCodeReveal.description: One audited reveal result. The full redeemable code is only available through this schema (and the export equivalent), always preceded by an audit-evidence row.

PromotionCodeExport.description: One audited batch export. Codes are ordered by `codeNo` and capped at 5000 rows.

count.description: Number of codes actually returned (never more than 5000).

truncated.description: True when the batch holds more codes than the 5000-row cap.

reason.description: Why the code is being disabled (trimmed, 1..256 characters). The actor is the authenticated operator; no request field can select it.
Why the code is being reissued (trimmed, 1..256 characters). The actor is the authenticated operator; no request field can select it.

code.description: Optional explicit replacement code. Trimmed and upper-cased before storage; 4–64 characters of `A-Z0-9-_`. Must be unique in the tenant (`409` on collision). Omit to generate the value from the batch's `codePrefix`/`codeLength`.

codeId.description: Newly issued replacement code id (`promotion_code.id`, TEXT).

codeMasked.description: Display mask of the replacement; never equal to the redeemable value, which only the audited reveal/export operations return.

codeLast4.description: Last four characters of the replacement.

replacedCodeId.description: Id of the disabled original (`promotion_code.id`, TEXT).

reason.description: Why the batch is being disabled (trimmed, 1..256 characters). The actor is the authenticated operator; no request field can select it.

disabledCount.description: Number of codes this operation disabled (`active` AND never claimed).

skippedCount.description: Codes of the batch the guard skipped (already claimed or no longer active).

reason.description: Why the coupon is being voided (trimmed, 1..256 characters). The actor is the authenticated operator; no request field can select it.

expiresAt.description: New expiry, RFC 3339 (`2026-12-01T00:00:00.000Z`) or the canonical server form (`2026-12-01 00:00:00`). Must be later than the database clock.
New expiry in the canonical RFC 3339 UTC shape (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ`).

settledAmountMinor.description: Amount that left the reservation pool and became spent, in integer minor units (int64 decimal string). `0` when the application never reserved budget.

releasedAmountMinor.description: Reservation returned to the available pool, in integer minor units (int64 decimal string). `0` when the application never reserved budget.

reason.description: Why the reservation is being released (trimmed, 1..256 characters). The actor is the authenticated operator; no request field can select it.
